plugins.name: slatemark
plugins.description: Market data and analytics for your AI. Connect a supported Claude client to delayed market data, technical calculations, SEC filings, and macroeconomic research. Your private journal and the installed analyst skill are optional context. Slatemark supplies factual tool results; Claude creates the response. Available tools depend on plan and configuration. A Slatemark account is required; Free includes one active AI-client connection.
